headline: Deadlocked adds PAL matches across drawing, object data and game helpers
summary: Deadlocked's PAL decompilation gained batches of matched functions covering drawing, object data, table lookups and game state. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. Tooling also gained support for reading a disc image from an explicit path.
highlights: A batch of 30 PAL functions merged (#54).
Drawing wrappers, object accessors, point transforms and smoothing routines gained matches (#57, #58, #60, #61).
Seventeen fixed-size hash lookups and a batch of 22 game functions merged (#72, #75).
Disc images can be read from an explicit path (#56).
Further PAL and NTSC-U matching proposals opened but remained unmerged (#55, #71, #77, #78, #79).
